say:1:1910329001:1.text: Once again, I can hear Mother Coral's loving voice through the currents.
say:1:1910329001:1.source_cn: 我听到，洋流再次捎来了母瑚慈爱的声音。

say:2:1910329002:1.text: It's breathing well now... Though it has lost some of its energy, it's still thriving. With enough nutrients to replenish its strength, the renewal season can go on as usual.
say:2:1910329002:1.source_cn: 它已重新呼吸……尽管失去了一些力量，但依旧充满生机。以...

say:3:1910329003:1.text: And the currents are rejoicing at the restoration of the Cradle Pool.
say:3:1910329003:1.source_cn: 我听到，水流为此欣喜不已。它们说：繁育池已恢复如初。

say:5:1910329004:1.text: Hooray! Grandma was right—as long as we stick together, there's nothing we can't do!
say:5:1910329004:1.source_cn: 太好了，阿嬷说得对，只要有家人和朋友在身边，就什么都能...

say:7:1910329005:1.text: I'm glad we managed to turn things around.
say:7:1910329005:1.source_cn: 还好大家及时挽回了事态。

say:8:1910329006:1.text: This incident has exposed weaknesses in Coralia's defenses. Moving forward, we'll place more coral structures to bolster our defenses—
say:8:1910329006:1.source_cn: 但这起事故也说明塔拉萨的防护仍有缺陷。后续工作中，我们...

say:10:1910329007:1.text: Alright, alright. Save your briefing for later.
say:10:1910329007:1.source_cn: 行了行了，现在没人想听你汇报工作。

say:11:1910329008:1.text: The Cradle Pool's fixed, yes, but does anyone have any idea why the Tidewarden descended earlier than usual?
say:11:1910329008:1.source_cn: 繁育池修好了。可波涛长者提前下潜这事，你们谁有头绪？

say:13:1910329009:1.text: The Tidewarden never responds to my voice, nor have I heard anything through the currents.
say:13:1910329009:1.source_cn: 波涛长者从不回应歌声的询问，洋流亦沉默不语。

say:14:1910329010:1.text: I'll add that to our list of important matters to address.
say:14:1910329010:1.source_cn: 这同样是后续需要处理的重要工作之一。

say:15:1910329011:1.text: One more thing, Menoa. I'd like to talk to you about these two visitors.
say:15:1910329011:1.source_cn: 还有另外一件事。摩淖亚。关于这两位陆地来的客人。

say:16:1910329012:1.text: Uncle Corvalli, please don't send them away! After all they've done for us, they're no longer outsiders!
say:16:1910329012:1.source_cn: 壳拉流斯大伯，你不能赶他们走！他们帮忙修复了繁育池，已...

say:17:1910329013:1.text: ... Elphira, you're picking up Fienna's impatience. Now, let me finish.
say:17:1910329013:1.source_cn: ……海月艾菲拉，不要学飞鳞的急性子，让我说完。

say:18:1910329014:1.text: Our rules forbid outsiders from participating in the renewal season.
say:18:1910329014:1.source_cn: 依照规定，外族成员不得参与洄游季。

say:19:1910329015:1.text: However, given their remarkable contributions to Coralia, I'd gladly welcome them into our <style="highlight">family</style>. What does everyone else think?
say:19:1910329015:1.source_cn: 但二位为塔拉萨做出了突出贡献，即便是外族成员，我也愿意...
say:19:1910329015:1.male: However, given their remarkable contributions to Coralia, I'd gladly welcome them into our <style="highlight">family</style>. What does everyone else think?
say:19:1910329015:1.female: However, given their remarkable contributions to Coralia, I'd gladly welcome them into our <style="highlight">family</style>. What does everyone else think?

say:21:1910329016:1.text: Sounds good to me. Someone as powerful as <style="stress"><player_name></style> would make a fine addition to our family.
say:21:1910329016:1.source_cn: 倒也合适。尤其是拥有强大力量的<style=stres...
say:21:1910329016:1.male: Sounds good to me. Someone as powerful as <style="stress"><player_name></style> would make a fine addition to our family.
say:21:1910329016:1.female: Sounds good to me. Someone as powerful as <style="stress"><player_name></style> would make a fine addition to our family.

say:22:1910329017:1.text: 随着飞鳞的话语，其他族长也纷纷表示了对你们——尤其是对你——的肯定。
say:22:1910329017:1.source_cn: 随着飞鳞的话语，其他族长也纷纷表示了对你们——尤其是对...

say:23:1910329018:1.text: You're both worthy of this honor. From now on, you're part of <style="highlight">our family</style>.
say:23:1910329018:1.source_cn: 你们足以获得如此殊荣。你们应成为塔拉萨的<style=...

choice_prompt:24:1910329018.female: You're both worthy of this honor. From now on, you're part of <style="highlight">our family</style>.

say:25:1910329019:1.text: The renewal season remains strictly off-limits to outsiders, and I have no intention of changing that.
say:25:1910329019:1.source_cn: 外族不得参与洄游季，这一点不可动摇。

say:26:1910329020:1.text: Technically, as of now, you two are still outsiders.
say:26:1910329020:1.source_cn: 从客观角度而言，你们现在依旧是外族，并非海裔。
say:26:1910329020:1.male: Technically, as of now, you two are still outsiders.
say:26:1910329020:1.female: Technically, as of now, you two are still outsiders.

say:27:1910329021:1.text: But that's fine. Please join us at the Cradle Pool tomorrow, when the renewal season officially begins.
say:27:1910329021:1.source_cn: 但无妨。明日，当洄游季正式开始，你们再来繁育池。
say:27:1910329021:1.male: But that's fine. Please join us at the Cradle Pool tomorrow, when the renewal season officially begins.
say:27:1910329021:1.female: But that's fine. Please join us at the Cradle Pool tomorrow, when the renewal season officially begins.

say:28:1910329022:1.text: By then, you'll truly be part of Coralia, and every clan will welcome you with open arms!
say:28:1910329022:1.source_cn: 你们将真正成为塔拉萨的一份子，所有族裔都将视你们为值得...
say:28:1910329022:1.male: By then, you'll truly be part of Coralia, and every clan will welcome you with open arms!
say:28:1910329022:1.female: By then, you'll truly be part of Coralia, and every clan will welcome you with open arms!

say:30:1910329023:1.text: My old friend... I'm glad to see you're not too old to embrace new ideas.
say:30:1910329023:1.source_cn: 呵呵……老朋友，看来，漫长的岁月并没有磨损你那颗懂得变...

say:31:1910329024:1.text: My darlings, I'm so happy all of you get to stay here for as long as you like. This calls for a celebration.
say:31:1910329024:1.source_cn: 孩子们，阿嬷真为你们高兴。现在，你们可以安安心心地留在...
say:31:1910329024:1.male: My darlings, I'm so happy all of you get to stay here for as long as you like. This calls for a celebration.
say:31:1910329024:1.female: My darlings, I'm so happy all of you get to stay here for as long as you like. This calls for a celebration.

say:32:1910329025:1.text: Wow, we'll have all the time in the world to hang out and explore new places! I'm so happy!
say:32:1910329025:1.source_cn: 嗯，你们想待多久就待多久。我们可以一直在一起玩，去好多...
say:32:1910329025:1.male: Wow, we'll have all the time in the world to hang out and explore new places! I'm so happy!
say:32:1910329025:1.female: Wow, we'll have all the time in the world to hang out and explore new places! I'm so happy!

say:33:1910329026:1.text: Aha! They should probably start deciding which clan to join now!
say:33:1910329026:1.source_cn: 哈！这么说，两个小家伙是不是也该挑选一下家族了？

say:34:1910329027:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, care to join my family, the Glidefin Clan? Once you've tried swimming with a tail, you'll never want to go back!
say:34:1910329027:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, care to join my family, the Glidefin Clan? Once you've tried swimming with a tail, you'll never want to go back!
say:34:1910329027:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, care to join my family, the Glidefin Clan? Once you've tried swimming with a tail, you'll never want to go back!

say:36:1910329028:1.text: The Coral Clan would be a better fit for him. Such immense power should be put to good use defending Coralia.
say:36:1910329028:1.male: The Coral Clan would be a better fit for him. Such immense power should be put to good use defending Coralia.
say:36:1910329028:1.female: The Coral Clan would be a better fit for her. Such immense power should be put to good use defending Coralia.

say:38:1910329029:1.text: We'd be happy to welcome you into the Tidesong Clan, too. I believe you have what it takes to understand the currents' messages.
say:38:1910329029:1.source_cn: 潮音同样欢迎你。你有出色的潜质，适合聆听洋流的声音。
say:38:1910329029:1.male: We'd be happy to welcome you into the Tidesong Clan, too. I believe you have what it takes to understand the currents' messages.
say:38:1910329029:1.female: We'd be happy to welcome you into the Tidesong Clan, too. I believe you have what it takes to understand the currents' messages.

say:39:1910329030:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Tolan are my friends! Of course they should join the Seamoon Clan!
say:39:1910329030:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Tolan are my friends! Of course they should join the Seamoon Clan!
say:39:1910329030:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Tolan are my friends! Of course they should join the Seamoon Clan!

say:40:1910329031:1.text: I'm sure they feel the same! Right, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:40:1910329031:1.male: I'm sure they feel the same! Right, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:40:1910329031:1.female: I'm sure they feel the same! Right, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

say:42:1910329032:1.text: My little jelly, we should let <style="stress"><player_name></style> and the fluffy child speak for themselves.

say:42:1910329032:1.male: My little jelly, we should let <style="stress"><player_name></style> and the fluffy child speak for themselves.
say:42:1910329032:1.female: My little jelly, we should let <style="stress"><player_name></style> and the fluffy child speak for themselves.

say:43:1910329033:1.text: Well, my darlings, how would you feel about joining my clan?
say:43:1910329033:1.source_cn: 孩子们，如何？你们愿意成为我们真正的家人吗？
say:43:1910329033:1.male: Well, my darlings, how would you feel about joining my clan?
say:43:1910329033:1.female: Well, my darlings, how would you feel about joining my clan?

say:45:1910329034:1.text: ... I'm in. My Waterstrider's still down, so I'm not going anywhere.
say:45:1910329034:1.source_cn: ……咱同意。咱的水行器还没修好，不能走。

say:46:1910329035:1.text: Plus, I'm having a much better time here than in Kaflan.
say:46:1910329035:1.source_cn: 再说了，在这待着，比在卡什澜待着舒服多了。

say:47:1910329036:1.text: What do you say, big guy?
say:47:1910329036:1.male: What do you say, big guy?

say:48:1910329037:1.text: 一众海裔们齐刷刷转头，目不转睛地盯着你。如果目光能化为实质，你应该已经被他们热切的眼神刺穿了。

say:50:1910329039:1.text: 成为海裔真正的家人，就能名正言顺地留在城中，探寻封印之地的线索。你似乎没有拒绝这一邀请的理由。

say:52:1910329040:1.source_cn: 欢迎你们加入塔拉萨，亲爱的孩子们！

say:53:1910329041:1.text: The renewal season will take place tomorrow.
say:53:1910329041:1.source_cn: 明天，洄游季就会正式开始。

say:54:1910329042:1.text: The Cradle Pool and Mother Coral will bear witness to your induction into our family.
say:54:1910329042:1.source_cn: 在繁育池与母瑚的见证下，你们将会成为我们真正的家人。

say:56:1910329044:1.text: Quite right, my little jelly. This is a momentous occasion for both the Seamoon Clan and all of Coralia.
say:56:1910329044:1.source_cn: 呵呵……小浪花说得对，无论对于海月家族，还是塔拉萨来说...

say:57:1910329045:1.text: We should hold a grand celebration in their honor. Let joy ripple through every current in Coralia!
say:57:1910329045:1.source_cn: 在这两个孩子加入塔拉萨的前夜，我们应该为他们举办一场隆...

say:65:1910329048:1.source_cn: 怎么会？在塔拉萨，迎接新的家人，就是最重要的事呀。
